extraction.notes: Read in full (8 pages, 30 numbered paragraphs): the opening statement of North Macedonia at the political intergovernmental conference of 19 July 2022. No item meets the scope. There is no Chapter 2 content: no mention of workers' rights or access, EURES, social security coordination or the European Health Insurance Card. There is no technology or AI claim. The only digital reference is paragraph 24, which expects the Green and Digital Agenda, with IPA III and the Economic and Investment Plan, to accelerate infrastructural and socio-economic development; the digital issue is not the subject of that claim, so it is an incidental reference under the materiality test. Paragraph 28 (responding to fake news and disinformation) concerns communication about the negotiations, not a technology issue. Paragraph 17 (compliance of around 45% with the acquis) is general and outside scope. The register lists Chapter 2 and all TECH themes against this source, but the text does not support them. Status complete with an empty items list. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2).
